name: calm
note: Natural, soft touches for text-led films. One tuned instrument plays both bell and text, soft air carries movement, and the lockup is one struck note.

tick.note: Dominoes knocking (CC0 fit, 0.14 s). It sits 3 dB higher because it is quieter at the same peak. Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member tap/glass stands in for fit/tick/domino; the level keeps the role's loudness.

tick.crisp.note: A glass touch, 98 ms: a 225 Hz body with a glass partial. Crisp, with no synthetic tink.

tock.note: A knuckle knock, the low partner of the glass tick.

hit.note: The lockup is one struck bell at C5. It has one attack, no lead-in and 1.9 s of natural decay. Set edits.pitch to the film's root to tune it.

land.note: A low, round thump (75 Hz body, 0.18 s) that you feel more than hear.

land.light.note: A soft fingertip thump for small elements.

pop.note: A mouth plop (CC0 fit, 0.28 s) with no pitch glide. Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member pro_pop_in/airy stands in for fit/pop/mouth_plop; the level keeps the role's loudness.

whoosh.short.note: One smooth pass of air (CC0 fit, 0.48 s). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member swipe/velvet stands in for fit/whoosh.short/bamboo_swish; the level keeps the role's loudness.

whoosh.long.note: A soft swell of air (1.36 s, peak at 0.44 s) for scene moves.

key.note: A mechanical key with a thock, a new take per keystroke. The light and laptop members ring, so the kit avoids them.

key.space.note: A mechanical space bar (CC0 fit, 0.39 s). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member typing_key/thock stands in for fit/key.space/thock_space; the level keeps the role's loudness.

key.return.note: A deep cap pressed harder, on its own seeds, 2.5 dB over the space bar.

click.note: A small plastic click (CC0 fit, 0.13 s, centroid 4.9 kHz). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member tap/finger stands in for fit/click/floss_lid; the level keeps the role's loudness.

click.confirm.note: A soft tuned pluck confirms an action. It is the bell and text voice, played quieter.

snap.note: A switch flip (CC0 fit, 0.19 s) with one attack. Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member toggle/latch stands in for fit/snap/switch_flip; the level keeps the role's loudness.

bell.note: Kalimba over 2 octaves of C pentatonic, 10 notes: one note per progress step or motif note.

text.note: One quiet tuned note when a text fragment completes, never once per word. It stays under the picture.

off.suck: a suck builds on top of the reveal
off.riser: the reveal lands on one sound; use pro_riser/air_gate when a film needs a build
off.drop: a calm film resolves without a sub drop; for weight, tune pro_sub_drop/soft to the root
off.swell: a reversed swell into the hit gives the hit a second gesture
